messages:
zoe: Heads-up 3 customer 'Sigma Health' flagged a surprise $6.4k burst charge on their Dedicated invoice for May. They claim reserved seats were moved between subaccounts and charges double-counted.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-305 generated for account sigma-health. Total $32,412. PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-305 (auto-note)
omar: Can you share the invoice lines?
zoe: Pulled lines (redacted):
```
LineItem: RESERVED_COMMIT   Period: 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31   Amount: $15,000   CommitID: rwd-commit-142   Seats: 25
LineItem: RESERVED_COMMIT_TRANSFER_PRORATE   Period: 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-10   Amount: $3,200   From: subacct-a To: subacct-b
LineItem: OVERAGE_BURST   Period: 2026-05-11 to 2026-05-31   Amount: $6,412
```
omar: I see the transfer prorate plus a separate reserved_commit line for the same seats in subacct-b 3 it looks like we billed both sides of the transfer.
finance-ops: Investigating. The transfer flow should create a prorate on the source side and then a reserved_commit on the destination only for the remaining period. If both were issued for full month that's a bug.
zoe: Sigma says they submitted the transfer on 2026-05-09 via partner-dashboard and included change request CR-8802.
billing-bot: Transfer event logged: transfer-ev-8802 processed at 2026-05-09T18:20:11Z.
omar: Cross-checking commit records 3 there are two commit lines: one created at 2026-05-01T00:02Z (initial reservation) and another created at 2026-05-10T03:14Z labeled rwd-commit-142-b. The proration job also inserted a transfer_prorate for the source. Looks like destination commit creation didn't mark the source as voided for overlapping seats.
finance-ops: Short-term remediation: issue a credit for the duplicated seats for the dates that were double-billed. Need approval for credit > $5k. Also need to notify partner that their transfer UI double-submitted the transfer event.
cfo: Please provide exact credit amount and confirm it only affects commit seats, not usage/overage calculations.
zoe: Calculated duplicated seat-days = 25 seats * 12 billed days = 300 seat-days. Rate per seat-day = $20.40 => duplicate amount $6,120. Overage $292 remains for actual burst. We should credit $6,120.
revenue-ops: Confirmed calculation method looks right. This is a commit misallocation, it doesn't affect token usage lines. Approve credit up to $10k.
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-0235 for $6,120 created (pending-post). Requires ticket BLG-3501.
finance-ops: Ticket BLG-3501 created: "Sigma Health transfer double-billing" assigned to eng-billing and partner-ops.
omar: Eng-billing: root cause likely missing atomic commit transfer transaction. Transfer job first created prorate, then destination commit creation retried and didn't check for existing transfer marker. We'll add a transfer-lock/tombstone to avoid double apply. ETA: patch deploy 2026-05-18.
cfo: Approve posting CM-2026-0235 after we confirm partner dedupe and update invoice. Also add note to chargeback model to ensure partner transfers are audited.
zoe: Once CM posts, please update invoice to INV-2026-305-v2 and ping partner-rep to send corrected PDF.
billing-bot: CM-2026-0235 posted. Invoice updated to INV-2026-305-v2. PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-305-v2
revenue-ops: I'll follow up with partner-ops to review their dashboard logs for a duplicate submit. Also running a query to find other transfers between 2026-05-05 and 2026-05-12 for similar patterns. Results will be attached to BLG-3501.
zoe: Thanks all. Customer notified and partner looped in. Leaving BLG-3501 for postmortem and rollout verification.
